name: Chiang Mai & Northern Thailand
about: Cool-dry season (Nov–Feb) is genuinely comfortable, even cool at night; Mar–Apr brings agricultural-burning haze that seriously degrades air quality and views.
overview: Cooler, hillier, and slower than Bangkok or the southern islands — temples, night markets, trekking, and the historic home of Thai massage.
costOverview: One of the cheapest places in Asia to eat well — even a specialty coffee costs a fraction of what it would back home.

specialSeasons.text: Agricultural burning across the region creates serious air-quality haze, worst in March–April — check air quality indexes before planning outdoor-heavy days.
The Yi Peng lantern festival fills the sky with thousands of floating lanterns — one of the most photographed events in Thailand.
